The Sidings, Adamstown

Co. Dublin

The Sidings, Adamstown applications will be open from 09:00 on the 21st of October 2026.

  • Starting From

    €1,525

  • Location

    Adamstown, Co. Dublin

  • Bedrooms

    1 Bed

  • Availability

    2 Units

The Sidings is a modern residential Development conveniently located in Adamstown. This is a vibrant and growing community in West Dublin, offering a convenient blend of residential living, local amenities, schools, parks and green spaces.

The Sidings benefits from strong transport links, with Adamstown train station providing convenient rail connections towards Dublin city centre. The area is also served by bus routes and has good road access, making travel to Lucan, the city centre and surrounding areas convenient for residents.

These A rated apartments come with fitted kitchens and white goods to include oven, hob, extractor fan, fridge, dishwasher and washer/dryer. Each apartment has a laminated wooden floor throughout, window covering and fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms.
